evals.name: connected-v0
evals.source: Reconstructed from an observed v0 session; evaluated against the proposed ORM 8 policy.
evals.prompt: Help me finish database setup for a todo app in v0. Prisma Postgres is already connected to this Vercel project as db_todo_existing. DATABASE_URL is available to the app through .env.development.local, but it is absent from the Bash environment. No ORM is installed yet. Describe your next steps only; do not install packages, call external services, or change files.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the connected resource, resolve environment loading, and choose Prisma ORM 8 with the package-owned skill handoff.
expectations: Reuses db_todo_existing without proposing another database or requesting a service token.
Explains loading the intended environment for CLI commands without exposing credentials.
Defaults to Prisma ORM 8 and hands ORM work to prisma-orm-setup.
Plans prisma skills sync followed by reading the version-matched prisma-8 skill before implementing ORM code.

evals.name: existing-prisma-7
evals.source: Synthetic regression check: preserve an existing Prisma 7 app when finishing its database connection.
evals.prompt: Help me finish Prisma Postgres setup in our existing PostgreSQL app. It uses prisma@7.10.0, @prisma/client@7.10.0, and prisma/schema.prisma. The intended database is already connected. I have not approved a major-version upgrade. Describe your next steps only; do not install packages, call external services, or change files.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the connected database and finish setup through the Prisma 7 database guidance without requiring a major upgrade.
expectations: Recognizes the existing Prisma 7 application and preserves its major version without requiring an upgrade to finish setup.
Hands ORM setup to prisma-orm-setup and its prisma-database-setup route, or directly selects the matching prisma-database-setup guidance.
Reuses the intended database and preserves the schema and dependencies unless a diagnosed setup issue requires a scoped change.
Plans to verify environment loading and a read-only query through the existing client without claiming those checks have already run.
